capabilities: Insert display math blocks with Alt+M
Expand shortcuts like /, ^, _ into fractions, superscripts and subscripts
Expand Greek letter names into LaTeX commands
Expand function names like sqrt, int, sum, vec, hat into LaTeX
disambiguation: It does not render equations or edit LaTeX generally; it only expands typed shortcuts inside math fields.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or newer; works on desktop and mobile keyboards. The marketplace listing carries an unreviewed-plugin warning.
intentEvidence: it helps you enter common notation more quickly inside Obsidian math fields
motivation: The author wants to recreate the WordMat input experience so users write notation comfortably instead of spending more time writing LaTeX.
problem: Typing LaTeX notation manually in math fields is slow for math and physics writing.

relations.evidence: A plugin simulating the WordMat experience

summary: Keyboard-shortcut plugin that expands WordMat-style abbreviations into LaTeX inside Obsidian math fields.
